Interface IDisplay

All Known Implementing Classes:
DashboardDisplay, ElementAccountBarDisplay, ElementProgressBarDisplay, LogInDisplay, TransparentFrameDisplay, TransparentPanelDisplay
public interface IDisplay
To be implemented by display elements, i.e. extensions of JFrame, JPanel. This class is used to synchronise the underlying Node tree with the display elements it corresponds to, and provide methods for IDisplay objects that facilitate injection and access to the parent node.
